verdicts.reason: A: The logo is blown up into a huge green outline that lies across the vegetables. This is an unintended collision and it distorts the brand. The date text is also tiny inside an inset white bar that doesn't run to either edge. B: The logo stays small inside the diamond, and the date has its own box, so it reads as a left-to-right banner. However, the diamond covers the produce, a pale tinted panel washes out the left side, and the green rule lines float loose on the image instead of framing the date.
